source: Chemical Science 2025, DOI 10.1039/D5SC00912J, supplied SI Table S2, page S35
interpretation: Single-ligand published yields at the paper's high-temperature conditions. Table S2 must not be merged with main-text Table 1, which uses differing precatalysts/conditions. Not measurements at 95 C; not pair-training data. Use as qualitative mechanistic prior only.
published_general_conditions: General SI procedure: Pd2(dba)3 5 mol% complex (10 mol% Pd atoms), ligand 20 mol%, toluene 0.2 M, 150 C, generally 18 h. PyFluor tBuBrettPhos example run 4 h. Table S2 itself does not specify every row's time/precatalyst separately.
air_precedent: SI S30: sealed PyFluor reaction with Pd2(dba)3 and tBuBrettPhos, toluene 0.1 M, 150 C, 4 h, 71% 19F NMR yield under air. This does not establish performance of Pd(COD)(DQ) at 95 C.
thesis_method: Repository src/prompts.py: supplied mechanism -> ligand properties -> complete scores; config.py sets five repetitions. Dual-ligand benchmark src/ligand_data.py concerns decarbonylative Suzuki coupling. Its ligand-relay analogy motivates hypotheses but cannot supply yields or a proven fluorination relay mechanism.
